about: The built-in Emitter Library. Each entry is captured natively (emitterlib.capture) from the stock map actors in source (maps names the Packages folder of each map: MapsEd maps load directly and are captured in the listed jobs; Maps-only maps are compiled, so MapRecovery first exports their actors natively, or decode reads them from the package where recovery stops early (decoded), and those actors are imported into a new map), then build_defaults.py applies tweaks and writes Reloaded.Editor/EmitterLibraryDefaults.gen.h. Order here is the order in the library. mode is continuous, periodic (repeats on its own with pauses) or triggered (hidden until an Event fires its Tag). Tweak ops: texture {from,to} swaps a pixel-identical or look-alike texture in a smaller shared package; untag drops a map-specific Tag; tag {value} renames a trigger Tag (placement prefixes it with RE_<id>_); offset {by} moves the actors relative to the pivot; set/remove {emitter,property[,value]} edit a sub-emitter (emitter = index in the actor's Emitters array); actorset/actorremove {property[,value]} edit the actor. preview is the camera hint for the explorer: target (relative to the pivot), radius and distance are computed from the particle extent and pitch/yaw default to 15 degrees down and 45 degrees round (Unreal rotation units); a preview here overrides any of them.

entries.name: Fire with smoke

tweaks.why: pixel-identical; SQU13_txt (3.6 MB) is shared with the barrel fire, PCF09_TXT is 9.6 MB
the flames spawn 50 units below the actor; this puts their base on the pivot
CpusS's smoke popped in and out at full size; it now fades and grows like the stock pipe smoke (SteeD.Emitter16611)

entries.description: An open fire with a lazy grey smoke column above it. Additive flame tongues (SQU13 flammes, a 3x2 flipbook, 20 at a time) lick up to about 50 units. An orange glow flare flickers at the base, and a few sparks (sfx ATT_flare) climb about 100 units. Ten alpha smoke puffs (sfx smoke_grenade, 10-35 units) rise 25-40 units a second from 50 units above the flames' base, fading in, growing to three times their size and fading out over 4 seconds. Place the pivot where the flames start, such as a barrel rim or a pile of burning debris. No light is included: add a flickering Light for the glow.

entries.name: Burning barrel

tweaks.why: the flames spawn 50 units below the actor; this puts their base on the pivot

entries.description: Oil-drum fire from the Steel mill: additive flame tongues (SQU13 flammes, a 3x2 flipbook) about 35 units across and up to 50 units tall, an orange glow flare, and a few sparks rising about 100 units. Place the pivot on the barrel's rim. No smoke and no light: use Fire with smoke for the smoke column, and add a flickering Light for the glow.

entries.name: Wall torch flame

tweaks.why: TorchFireGood only groups the PyroD torches

entries.description: The crypt torch flame from PyroD, the most-placed fire in the stock maps. Two animated flame sheets (crypt_txt FireSmallPart and FirePart, 25-40 units, following the actor) rise about 100 units. Glowing sparks drift up from 30 units above the base. Place the pivot at the top of the torch or brazier. crypt_txt is a 10 MB texture package, so the first placement takes a moment. No light is included: add a warm Light for the glow.

entries.name: Gas flare jet
entries.description: The oil rig's flare stack from OffsD: a roaring 200-unit-wide flame (Oilrig flame, 30 alpha and 50 additive sprites) shot about 600 units up in 1.5 seconds and bent by the wind toward +X and +Y, shrinking to nothing as it rises. DrawScale 10 only widens the culling bounds so the big flame is not clipped. For the top of a flare stack, burning pipe or chimney.

entries.name: Hot coals: embers and steam
entries.description: Sauna-stove coals from ClubD: tiny glowing embers (CLU04 CLU_fx_sparks, additive) spiral up from a 128 x 64 unit bed while 20 soft steam puffs (FX_steam_occlude2, 15-20 units growing to 60) rise gently above them. Place the pivot on top of the coals or embers.

entries.name: Large distant smoke plume
entries.description: A huge dark smoke column for skylines and backdrops, from OrphD. 26 sprites (sfx smoke_grenade, 250-650 units wide) live 15-20 seconds and are blown 250-450 units a second along +X with a slow lift, so the plume stretches thousands of units downwind. DrawScale 10 only widens the culling bounds. Place it far from the play area; turn the actor to change the drift.

entries.name: Chimney smoke

tweaks.why: pixel-identical copy in a 135 KB package instead of 1.4 MB
the museum rumble does not belong to a generic chimney

entries.description: Soft grey smoke puffs from a roof vent or chimney, from MuseD. Four sprites (MHOsfx fumee_tuyau_light, 20-40 units) leave the vent, grow to four times their size and drift toward +X with a slight lift for about 4 seconds. Place the pivot at the chimney mouth.

entries.name: Smouldering smoke
entries.description: Thick slow smoke from something smouldering, from BankD: 15 alpha puffs (sfx smoke_grenade, 30 units) fade in, rise slowly and spread to about 240 units wide over 6 seconds, drifting a little toward -X. Only uses the always-loaded sfx package. Place the pivot at the source of the smoke.

entries.name: Engine exhaust puffs
entries.description: Short grey puffs from a running vehicle's tailpipe, with the engine loop sound (Amb_Gare gar_moteurLoop), from StatD. Puffs (sfx smoke_grenade, 5-10 units growing to 25) shoot out 150-200 units a second along the actor's +X, slow down sharply and fade within a second. Place at the tailpipe and turn the actor so +X points out of it.

entries.name: Steam vent (grate)

tweaks.why: pixel-identical; CLU04_TXT (2 MB) is shared with the other steam entries, GAR_TXT is 4 MB

entries.description: A wide sheet of white steam rising from a grate or manhole with a steam hiss (Amb_Gare Mis_vapeur), from StatD. 15 alpha sprites (FX_steam_occlude2) spawn along a 180-unit line on X, rise and billow to about 300 units wide while drifting slightly toward -X. Place the pivot on the grate.

entries.name: Steam from a pipe
entries.description: A soft grey-green steam plume leaking from a pipe end, from SteeD, where it is placed 41 times. Seven alpha puffs (sfx smoke_grenade, 30-40 units growing six-fold) leave along the actor's +X, which points straight up, and drift upward for 4 seconds. Visible to thermal vision. Turn the actor to change the direction the steam leaves the pipe.

entries.name: Steam jet (hissing)
entries.description: A steady hissing steam jet from machinery, with the Jet_Vapeur sound (amb_Belew), from DeftD. Eight alpha puffs (DTK fumee_tuyau, 10 units growing to 50) shoot 40-70 units a second along the actor's +X and curl upward over 2 seconds. Place at the leak and turn the actor so +X points out of it.

entries.name: Sauna steam haze
entries.description: A slow translucent haze filling a steam room, with the sauna ambience (Amb_Club clu_saunaFum), from the ClubD bathhouse. Three large grey sheets (FX_steam_occlude2, 100-140 units) fade in and out over 3 seconds and barely move. Place in the middle of the room at head height.

entries.name: Cold vapour spilling down
entries.description: Vapour pouring down out of an opening, like cold air from a freezer or steam from a ceiling vent, with the sauna ambience (Amb_Club clu_saunaFum), from ClubD. 25 white puffs (FX_steam_occlude2, 40-50 units growing to double) spawn along a 128-unit line on Y, 30 units below the pivot, and sink 40-50 units a second. Place the pivot at the opening.

entries.name: Rising bubbles
entries.description: A column of rising bubbles for aquariums and underwater scenes, with a bubbling sound (Amb_Aqua Aqua_bulle), from AquaD. Up to 60 additive bubbles (Aquarium bubulles, a 4x4 flipbook, 1-5 units growing to double) wobble slightly and rise about 100 units over 3-4 seconds. Place the pivot at the air stone or bottom of the column.

entries.name: Ceiling drips
entries.description: Occasional water drops falling fast from a damp ceiling, from OrphD. About two drops a second (ORP_Gouttes) appear over a 100 x 100 area, fall with strong gravity and stop where they hit the floor (particle collision). Place the pivot just under the ceiling.

entries.name: Drip with splash

tweaks.why: the drop falls 243 units in its 1.8 s life; starting it that high lands it on the splash
the splash sat 350 units below the actor; it now plays at the pivot

entries.description: A slow single drip with a tiny bright splash where it lands, from the ScheE sewers. Drops (SFX_SCH water_drops) start 243 units above the pivot and fall onto it, where small splash sprites (water_drops_giclure, Brighten) burst up. Place the pivot on the floor or water surface under the leak.

entries.name: Drip into a puddle

tweaks.why: the drops now start where the ceiling was, 382 units above the puddle
falling at 60 units/s/s a drop reaches the puddle after 3.55 s; the default 4 s carried it through the floor
the ripples sat 382 units below the actor; they now spread at the pivot

entries.description: Water drips into a puddle from ShadD: a drop (sfx fx_sprinkler) falls from 382 units up every second, and a ripple ring (sfx impact_onde, lying flat and growing) spreads on the puddle every second with a drip sound (amb_Belew Ogout2). Only uses sfx textures. Place the pivot on the puddle; with a lower ceiling the drops simply appear from it.

entries.name: Leaking pipe spray
entries.description: A fine mist of water squirting from a cracked pipe, from the ScheE sewers. 15 grey spray sprites (SFX_SCH Water_spray) shoot out along the actor's +X, which is turned 47 degrees down, grow six-fold and vanish within 0.6 seconds. Place at the crack and turn the actor to aim the spray.

entries.name: Shower spray
entries.description: Water pouring from a shower head, from the PrisD showers. 70 bright drops a second (sfx fx_gouttes, a 4x4 flipbook, turned to follow their motion) leave the nozzle along the actor's +X, which points up, and fall about 240 units in 2 seconds. Place the pivot at the shower head.

entries.name: Sea wave spray (periodic)
entries.description: Periodic: every 5-15 seconds a wave hits and throws up a burst of 15 big white spray sprites (Aquarium FX_embrun, 50-150 units), which fly 300-700 units up and 300-400 units toward -Y, then fall back over 2-3 seconds. From the AquaD sea wall. Place the pivot where the waves break, with -Y pointing inland.

entries.name: Waterfall foam and ripples

tweaks.why: puts the ripple emitter, which lies on the pool surface, on the pivot

entries.description: White foam and ripple rings where falling water hits a pool, from the ClubD garden waterfall. One emitter churns 30 foam puffs (sfx extincteur_hud) along a 150-unit line on Y; the other spreads ripple rings (sfx impact_onde, 70-80 units) that flow away toward -X. Place the pivot where a waterfall or pipe mesh meets the water surface.

entries.name: Flowing water ripples
entries.description: Ripple rings flowing across a pool or stream, from the ClubD garden. Four rings (sfx impact_onde, 30-40 units growing by half) lie flat on the water and drift 50-60 units a second toward -X. Place the pivot on the water surface; combine several along a stream.

entries.name: Water stream from a pipe

tweaks.why: weather only groups the ClarD rain

entries.description: Thin streaks of water pouring from a pipe outlet or gutter, from ClarD. Two long streaks (claritysoft Rain, stretched 100-500 units along their motion) fall 1400 units a second from a 96 x 96 opening. Place the pivot at the outlet.

entries.name: Rain curtain

tweaks.why: weather only groups the ClarD rain
ClarD's strip is 1024 x 8192; a 1024 x 2048 area suits most maps
keeps ClarD's density (360 over 8192 units) on the smaller area

entries.description: Falling rain streaks for outdoor areas, from ClarD. 90 streaks (claritysoft Rain, stretched 100-1000 units along their motion) fall 2000 units a second from a 1024 x 2048 area and live 1.5 seconds. Place the pivot high above the area; the streaks fall about 3000 units. The game's own rain uses ERainVolume; this is the emitter version. Pair it with Rain ground splashes.

entries.name: Rain ground splashes

tweaks.why: weather only groups the ClarD rain

entries.description: Raindrops splashing on the ground, from ClarD. Up to 80 bright splash sprites (SFX_SCH water_drops_giclure, Brighten) pop and fade within half a second across a 1216 x 384 area. Place the pivot on the ground under a Rain curtain.

entries.name: Snowfall (blizzard)

tweaks.why: ShadD's box is 3000 x 5000 x 2150; a 2048 x 2048 x 1174 box suits most maps
half of ShadD's 1200, on a box a quarter of its area

entries.description: Wind-driven snow for outdoor areas, from the ShadD blizzard. 150 flakes a second (ShadowMoses schneeflocke, 2-3 units, additive) appear in a 2048 x 2048 area up to 1024 units above the pivot, blow 300-500 units a second toward -X while falling, and stop where they hit the ground (particle collision). Place the pivot at ground level; move it upwind, since the snow drifts about 1600 units toward -X.

entries.name: Blowing mist
entries.description: Faint wisps of mist or powder snow blown across the ground, from PolaD. Ten wisps a second (sfx extincteur_hud, 30-60 units growing to triple, at most a tenth opaque) appear over a 900 x 400 area and race 300-600 units a second toward +Y. Only uses sfx textures. Place the pivot just above the ground.

entries.name: Electrical sparks shower
entries.description: Hot sparks spitting from a faulty cable or junction box, with an electric crackle (Amb_Tme Tme_elec), from ClarD. Bursts of additive sparks (sfx decal_metal_hotspot) shoot 100-200 units a second up and outward and fall back under gravity within a second; a new burst follows every 1-5 seconds. Place the pivot at the fault.

entries.name: Electric arcs
entries.description: Blue electric arcs crawling up an electrified fence or transformer, from FactD. Two additive arc sprites (FAC_TXT FX_electricfence_0, a 2x4 flipbook, 80 units wide) flicker and climb 100-250 units, facing the actor's Y axis. Place the pivot at the bottom of the fence and turn the actor so the arcs lie in the fence plane.

entries.name: Floating dust motes

tweaks.why: Penitentiary_TXT is a 34.5 MB package; the always-loaded sfx has a small look-alike speck
with the range below the box is centred on the pivot instead of off to one side
PrisD's 140 x 75 x 190 box, moved so it sits over the pivot

entries.description: Tiny pale specks drifting slowly in the air, as in a shaft of light, from PrisD. 20 additive specks (sfx spark2, 1-3 units, tinted pale yellow) fade in and out over 2.5 seconds inside a 140 x 75 x 190 box above the pivot, moving with the actor. Place the pivot on the floor under a window or lamp.

entries.name: Moths around a light
entries.description: Three moths fluttering erratically around a lamp, from PrisD. Each moth (SFX_SCH butterfly, a 3x3 wing-beat flipbook, Brighten, 6 units) circles and darts within about 60 units of the pivot and is replaced every 0.7 seconds. Place the pivot just below the lamp.

entries.name: Searchlight beam glow

tweaks.why: spotlights_emitter only ties it to the ShadD searchlight mover
the attachment tag is dropped, so there is nothing to attach to

entries.description: A soft volumetric searchlight beam, from ShadD. Eight faint glow sprites (ShadowMoses corona1, Brighten) spaced 80 units apart along X grow from 100 to 240 units wide and dim toward the far end, making a 560-unit beam. In ShadD it rides a rotating searchlight; this copy is static. Place the pivot at the lamp lens and pair it with a spotlight.

entries.name: Gas explosion (triggered)

tweaks.why: boomgaz3 was the SteeD trigger name; placement prefixes the Tag with RE_<id>_

entries.description: Triggered: shows nothing until an Event matching its Tag fires, then plays once per trigger. A gas-bottle blast from SteeD: a burst of shrapnel, a fireball of 11 flipbook flames (sfx frag_grenade, 80-120 units), a smoke puff spreading to 250 units, burning streaks thrown high into the air and a tall column of dark smoke rising for 7 seconds. Placing gives it the Tag RE_<id>_GasExplosion; set a trigger's Event to that Tag. Add the sound and damage separately.

entries.name: Electrical short (triggered)

tweaks.why: electro_box_4 was the ClubD trigger name; placement prefixes the Tag with RE_<id>_

entries.description: Triggered: shows nothing until an Event matching its Tag fires, then plays once per trigger. An electrical box shorting out, from ClubD: a spray of white-hot sparks (sfx spark_metal) shot 300-500 units a second, a bright flash streak (flare_fixe) and falling glass shards (glassbreaking3), all along the actor's +X, which points down as it was mounted under a ceiling box. Placing gives it the Tag RE_<id>_ElectricalShort; set a trigger's Event to that Tag. Turn the actor to aim it.

entries.name: Pressure valve steam burst (triggered)

tweaks.why: pression05 was the MissD trigger name; placement prefixes the Tag with RE_<id>_

entries.description: Triggered: shows nothing until an Event matching its Tag fires, then plays once per trigger. A pressure valve venting, from MissD: 15 white steam puffs (sfx smoke_grenade) blast out at 600 units a second along the actor's +X, slow down sharply and billow to four times their size within a second. Placing gives it the Tag RE_<id>_SteamBurst; set a trigger's Event to that Tag. Turn the actor to aim it.

entries.name: Falling dust (triggered)

tweaks.why: passerelle was the MissD trigger name; placement prefixes the Tag with RE_<id>_

entries.description: Triggered: shows nothing until an Event matching its Tag fires, then plays once per trigger. Brown dust shaken loose from a catwalk or ceiling, from MissD: for 5 seconds, ten dust puffs a second (sfx extincteur_hud, 10-15 units growing to triple) fall from a 60 x 60 patch and fade within 2 seconds. Placing gives it the Tag RE_<id>_DustFall; set a trigger's Event to that Tag. Place the pivot just under the catwalk or ceiling.
